upi.title: UPI & QR Code Protection
upi.summary: Understand UPI collect mechanics and why you never, under any circumstance, enter a PIN to receive money.
upi.sec1Content: A UPI PIN is used exclusively to AUTHORIZE MONEY DEBIT from your bank account. Receiving funds via UPI requires ZERO PIN entries.
upi.sec1Bullet1: Scanning a QR code always initiates an OUTGOING transaction, never an incoming credit.
upi.sec1Bullet2: Deceptive 'Collect Requests' on phone apps disguise themselves as cashback or refund claims.
upi.sec1Bullet3: Never enter a PIN on an unsolicited SMS or WhatsApp payment link.
upi.sec2Heading: Immediate Action If Scammed via UPI
upi.sec2Content: Immediately call National Cyber Helpline 1930 to freeze the beneficiary account during the crucial golden window, then freeze UPI access in your mobile banking app.
upi.q1Question: A buyer on an online marketplace sends a QR code claiming: 'Scan this QR and enter your 4-digit PIN to receive ₹5,000 in your account.' What will happen?
upi.q1OptA: You will safely receive ₹5,000 in your bank account.
upi.q1OptAExp: Incorrect. Entering a PIN will immediately DEBIT ₹5,000 from your account.
upi.q1OptB: ₹5,000 will be instantly debited from your bank account.
upi.q1OptBExp: Correct! UPI PIN is only used to send money, never to receive. Entering a PIN will immediately debit your account.
upi.q1OptC: The transaction will pause until the buyer confirms payment.
upi.q1OptCExp: Incorrect. The payment goes through immediately once you type your PIN.
upi.goldenRule: Golden Rule: PIN is only for sending money, never for receiving.

arrest.title: Anatomy of 'Digital Arrest' Scams
arrest.summary: Recognize how criminal syndicates impersonate police officers, CBI, and telecom officials on video calls to extort money.
arrest.sec1Content: No legitimate law enforcement agency in India (Police, CBI, ED, NIA, or Customs) will ever place citizens under 'digital arrest' or interrogate them over Skype or WhatsApp video calls.
arrest.sec1Bullet1: Police officers never issue official notices or warrants via WhatsApp chats.
arrest.sec1Bullet2: Courts and investigative agencies never demand fund transfers to 'RBI verification accounts' for bail.
arrest.sec1Bullet3: Government departments do not demand you stay isolated in a hotel or locked room on continuous video surveillance.
arrest.sec2Content: Sever the video call immediately. Do not panic. Dial 1930 or visit your local police station in person to verify.
arrest.q1Question: A caller in a police uniform on a WhatsApp video call tells you your Aadhaar was used in illegal drug trafficking and orders you to transfer ₹2,00,000 to a 'court verification account'. What should you do?
arrest.q1OptA: Transfer the money immediately to avoid arrest.
arrest.q1OptAExp: Dangerous! This is an extortion syndicate. Police never demand money transfers over video calls.
arrest.q1OptB: Hang up immediately, block the number, and dial 1930.
arrest.q1OptBExp: Correct! 'Digital arrest' is a complete fabrication used by organized extortion syndicates.
arrest.q1OptC: Ask the officer for an official receipt before transferring.
arrest.q1OptCExp: Incorrect. Scammers generate forged receipts and fake seal stamps.
arrest.goldenRule: Golden Rule: Indian police never interrogate or arrest citizens over Skype or WhatsApp video calls.

invest.title: Work-From-Home & Investment Traps
invest.summary: Deconstruct fake Google review rating tasks, Telegram VIP investment channels, and manipulated crypto trading dashboards.
invest.sec1Content: Scammers initially pay small sums (₹200 - ₹500) for trivial tasks (liking YouTube videos, reviewing hotels) to earn initial trust, then induce victims into 'prepaid investment tasks'.
invest.sec1Bullet1: Victims are added to fake Telegram groups where other 'members' (bots/accomplices) share fabricated screenshot earnings.
invest.sec1Bullet2: The fraudulent dashboard displays massive virtual profits, but real withdrawals are blocked unless higher 'taxes' or 'unlock fees' are paid.
invest.sec1Bullet3: No legitimate brokerage or institutional trading account operates out of private Telegram chats.
invest.sec2Content: Never transfer money to participate in 'paid tasks' or unregistered wealth schemes. Verify all investment advisors on SEBI's official portal (sebi.gov.in).
invest.q1Question: A Telegram group admin promises 300% monthly returns on an exclusive stock trading app, but you must first deposit ₹50,000 to activate your trading ID. What is the reality?
invest.q1OptA: It is a fraudulent Ponzi scheme; your deposited money will be stolen.
invest.q1OptAExp: Correct! Guaranteed exorbitant returns on private messaging apps are 100% fraudulent.
invest.q1OptB: It is an authorized institutional private placement scheme.
invest.q1OptBExp: Incorrect. Legitimate financial investments never promise guaranteed 300% returns on Telegram.
invest.q1OptC: You can invest as long as you withdraw after the first week.
invest.q1OptCExp: Incorrect. Scammers prevent withdrawals and demand additional 'service fees'.
invest.goldenRule: Golden Rule: Guaranteed massive returns on Telegram or WhatsApp are always scams.

apk.title: Malicious APKs & Screen Sharing
apk.summary: Discover why fraudsters send .apk files disguised as electricity bill updates or urge installation of AnyDesk/QuickSupport.
apk.sec1Content: Sideloaded Android APKs request dangerous accessibility and SMS permissions. Once installed, malware intercepts two-factor bank OTPs and transfers funds silently.
apk.sec1Bullet1: Utility companies (electricity, gas, water) NEVER distribute mobile applications via direct WhatsApp APK files or media fire links.
apk.sec1Bullet2: Remote screen-sharing tools allow strangers to watch you type bank passwords and debit card numbers in real time.
apk.sec1Bullet3: Keep 'Install unknown apps' disabled in phone settings at all times.
apk.sec2Content: If an unauthorized APK was installed, turn on Airplane Mode immediately to disconnect network connectivity, uninstall the application, and notify your bank.
apk.q1Question: An SMS says: 'Urgent: Electricity power disconnection tonight! Call official 9876543210 or install BijliUpdate.apk immediately.' What is the safest action?
apk.q1OptA: Download the APK quickly to prevent your power from being cut.
apk.q1OptAExp: Dangerous! That APK is malware designed to steal banking OTPs and passwords.
apk.q1OptB: Call the phone number in the message to ask for proof.
apk.q1OptBExp: Incorrect. The number connects directly to the scam syndicate.
apk.q1OptC: Ignore the message and verify your account balance on the official discom website or call 1912.
apk.q1OptCExp: Correct! Official electricity boards never distribute APK files or threaten immediate disconnection via random mobile numbers.
apk.goldenRule: Golden Rule: Never download .apk files from WhatsApp or SMS. Always verify utility bills via official 1912 helpline.

seniors.title: Senior Citizen Digital Defense
seniors.summary: Practical, empowering digital security habits designed for elderly family members and retired citizens navigating digital banking.
seniors.sec1Content: Cyber syndicates deliberately target seniors using artificial urgency, pension account expiry threats, and deepfake voice calls simulating distressed relatives.
seniors.sec1Bullet1: Set up a secret 'Family Safe-Word' to authenticate unexpected distress calls claiming a family member is in police custody.
seniors.sec1Bullet2: Keep primary savings in a bank account without net-banking/UPI enabled, using a separate small-balance account for daily grocery UPI transactions.
seniors.sec1Bullet3: Never allow strangers who call claiming to be bank executives to guide you through phone settings.
seniors.sec2Content: Establish a household rule: Any call demanding money or threatening legal consequences requires a 5-minute pause and confirmation with a trusted family member.
seniors.q1Question: You receive an urgent phone call sounding like your grandchild claiming they met with a car accident and need an immediate ₹40,000 hospital transfer. What should you do first?
seniors.q1OptA: Transfer the money immediately to help the grandchild.
seniors.q1OptAExp: Dangerous! Scammers use AI voice cloning to mimic loved ones and induce panic.
seniors.q1OptB: Pause, hang up, and call the grandchild's direct phone number or another family member to verify.
seniors.q1OptBExp: Correct! Always pause and independently verify emergency distress calls through known family contacts.
seniors.q1OptC: Pay half the amount first to confirm.
seniors.q1OptCExp: Incorrect. Never send any funds before independent verification.
seniors.goldenRule: Golden Rule: In urgent distress calls, pause and verify directly with family before sending money.
